node.title: cpanm says OK but module not really installed
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: I installed a cpan module with cpanm which reports: 1 distribution installed. All I can find is an install.json and an empty .packlist. Also "perllocal.pod" is appended! I browsed the module files on cpan but can't figure out why this happens with [cpan://Astro::SpaceElevator] (and its spiffy utf8 source: my $Δ = $P - $V).
